manual_session_actions.name: GitHub Copilot fleet mode

detectors.pattern: (?m)^\s*(/fleet)\s+Enable fleet mode for parallel subagent execution\s*$

maintenance.instruction: Run /fleet in the current Copilot CLI session, then continue the original task.

manual_session_actions.guidance: Enable fleet mode for parallel subagent execution in the current Copilot CLI session after approval.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
tools.install: Install a GitHub Copilot CLI release with default subagent support from the official GitHub distribution.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade GitHub Copilot CLI with its supported updater so the required default subagent capability is available.

tools.name: CodeGraph
tools.install: Install CodeGraph and expose the codegraph command to Copilot CLI.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade CodeGraph with its installation package manager.

tools.name: Tokscale
tools.install: Install the latest Tokscale release globally and expose the tokscale command on PATH.
tools.upgrade: Upgrade Tokscale to the latest release with the package manager used to install it.
